customer_id.meaning: Primary id of the customer profile; one profile per claimant (an individual) or per employer (a business entity).

customer_type.meaning: Whether the profile belongs to an individual benefit claimant or to an employer registered for unemployment insurance tax.

name.meaning: Legal name of the claimant, or registered legal business name of the employer, exactly as on file.

phone_number.meaning: Phone number of record for the claimant or the employer's account contact.

email.meaning: Email address of record used for notices and online account access.

tax_id_last4.meaning: Last four digits of the claimant's Social Security number, or of the employer's Federal Employer Identification Number.

date_of_birth.meaning: Claimant date of birth as verified at registration; empty on employer profiles.

mailing_address.meaning: Street address of record to which determinations and notices are mailed.

mailing_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the mailing address of record.

profile_opened_date.meaning: Date the customer profile was first created with the agency.

verification_id.meaning: Primary id of the caller verification record, one per customer profile (content hash of the customer id).

customer_id.meaning: Customer whose identity the caller claimed (foreign key -> customers).

verified.meaning: Whether the caller passed identity verification on this contact; never reverts from true to false.

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: Moment of the most recent verification attempt.

handoff_id.meaning: Primary id of the transfer-to-representative record.

customer_id.meaning: Customer transferred to a human representative (foreign key -> customers).

reason.meaning: Reason for the transfer; closed set of exactly these two values.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

claim_id.meaning: Primary id of the claim record (one claim under one program for one benefit year).

customer_id.meaning: Claimant who holds the claim (foreign key -> customers).

variant_name.meaning: Benefit program of the claim, written as the official program name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle status of the claim as defined in the claim charter lifecycle.

filed_date.meaning: Date the initial claim was filed.

effective_date.meaning: Claim effective date: the Sunday of the week the claim was filed, or the earlier Sunday after approved backdating.

benefit_year_end_date.meaning: Last day of the benefit year or eligibility period of the claim.

base_period_type.meaning: Base period used by the latest monetary determination; not_applicable for programs without a wage test or before determination.

base_period_start_quarter.meaning: First calendar quarter of the base period used.

base_period_end_quarter.meaning: Last calendar quarter of the base period used.

high_quarter_wages.meaning: Wages in the highest-paid quarter of the base period used by the latest determination.

base_period_wages.meaning: Total wages in the base period used by the latest determination.

weekly_benefit_amount.format: USD, whole dollars with 2 decimal places
weekly_benefit_amount.meaning: Weekly benefit amount set by the latest monetary determination, excluding dependency allowance.

dependents_count.meaning: Dependents on record for the dependency allowance.

dependency_allowance.meaning: Weekly dependency allowance set by the latest monetary determination.

max_benefit_amount.format: USD, whole dollars with 2 decimal places
max_benefit_amount.meaning: Maximum benefit amount set by the latest monetary determination.

remaining_balance.meaning: Benefits still payable on the claim; always equal to the sum of the remaining_benefit_balance deltas in claim_ledger (credits minus debits).

monetary_status.meaning: Outcome of the latest monetary determination; pending before the first determination.

determination_number.meaning: Number of the latest monetary determination; 1 is the original and 2 or more are redeterminations.

monetary_determination_date.meaning: Date the latest monetary determination was issued.

separation_reason.meaning: Separation from the most recent employer as reported at filing or at the latest additional claim.

separating_employer_account_id.meaning: Employer tax account of the most recent separating employer (foreign key -> employer_accounts); empty for UCFE, UCX, DUA and self-employment.

recall_date.meaning: Definite recall date given by the employer for a temporary layoff.

approved_training.meaning: Whether the claimant is currently enrolled in agency-approved training.

parent_claim_id.meaning: For Extended Benefits and Trade Readjustment Allowances claims, the exhausted claim being extended (foreign key -> claims); empty otherwise.

disaster_declaration_date.format: YYYY-MM-DD; empty when not a DUA claim
disaster_declaration_date.meaning: Date the major disaster declaration covering a Disaster Unemployment Assistance claim was announced.

hold_reason.meaning: Issue holding payment on the claim; none when no hold is in force.

payment_method.meaning: Payment method in force for payments issued on or after payment_method_effective_date.

payment_method_effective_date.meaning: First payment date on which the current payment method is used.

closed_date.format: YYYY-MM-DD; empty while not closed or withdrawn
closed_date.meaning: Date the claim was closed at benefit year end or withdrawn.

certification_id.meaning: Primary id of the weekly certification record.

event_type.meaning: Event family of the row, from the claim charter.

week_ending_date.meaning: Saturday ending the certified benefit week.

cert_channel.meaning: Channel through which the week was certified.

cert_timeliness.meaning: Timeliness classification of the certification under the weekly certification policy.

able_and_available.meaning: Claimant's answer that they were able and available for full-time work all week.

work_refused.meaning: Whether the claimant reported refusing an offer of work during the week.

gross_earnings.meaning: Gross earnings for work performed in the week (reported in the week worked, not the week paid).

work_search_contacts.meaning: Work-search contacts reported for the week.

other_pay_type.meaning: Kind of other pay reported for the week; none when no other pay.

other_pay_amount.meaning: Weekly amount (weekly-prorated for a pension) of the other pay reported; 0.00 when none.

ledger_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the claim ledger entry.

event_type.meaning: Event family of the row, from the claim charter.

entry_date.meaning: Date the entry was booked; for a payment, the issue date.

determination_number.format: integer; 0 when not an entitlement entry
determination_number.meaning: Monetary determination number that produced an entitlement credit or reduction.

payment_kind.meaning: Kind of benefit payment; not_applicable for non-payment entries.

amount.meaning: Amount of the entry; the account direction is given by the event family (credits in, payments and reductions out).

earnings_deduction.meaning: Deduction for gross earnings above the disregard in a payment; 0.00 otherwise.

other_pay_deduction.meaning: Deduction for deductible vacation, holiday or pension pay in a payment; 0.00 otherwise.

offset_amount.meaning: Part of a payment applied to an overpayment balance; 0.00 when none.

offset_applied.meaning: Whether an overpayment offset was taken from this payment.

withholding_applied.meaning: Whether an income tax, child support or SNAP deduction was taken from this payment.

charge_code.meaning: How a payment is charged to base-period employers; not_applicable for non-payment entries.

payment_method.meaning: Method through which a payment was issued; not_applicable for non-payment entries.

original_payment_id.meaning: For a cancellation or a reissue, the single original payment entry it refers to (foreign key -> claim_ledger); empty otherwise.

cancel_reason.meaning: Why a payment was cancelled; none for other entries.

statement_id.meaning: Primary id of the Form 1099-G statement record.

event_type.meaning: Event family of the row, from the claim charter.

federal_tax_withheld.meaning: Box 4 federal income tax withheld reported.

state_tax_withheld.meaning: Box 11 state income tax withheld reported.

correction_reason.meaning: original for the annual statement; otherwise the reason a corrected statement was issued.

request_id.meaning: Primary id of the claim request lodged for back-office decision or claimant confirmation.

claim_id.meaning: Claim the request concerns (foreign key -> claims).

requested_effective_date.format: YYYY-MM-DD (Sunday); empty unless request_type is backdate
requested_effective_date.meaning: Earlier effective date asked for in a backdate request.

requested_week_ending_date.format: YYYY-MM-DD (Saturday); empty unless request_type is late_certification
requested_week_ending_date.meaning: Week the claimant asks to certify late.

good_cause_reason.meaning: Good cause stated for a backdate or late certification request; none for withdrawals.

request_status.meaning: Outcome of the request; confirmed_by_claimant applies only to withdrawals.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

idv_case_id.meaning: Primary id of the identity verification case (one case per claim at a time).

customer_id.meaning: Claimant whose identity is verified (foreign key -> customers).

claim_id.meaning: Claim the case belongs to (foreign key -> claims).

variant_name.meaning: Proofing pathway the case is currently on, written as the official pathway name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle status of the case as defined in the idv charter lifecycle.

notice_date.meaning: Date the identity verification notice was sent; the deadline is counted from it.

verification_deadline.meaning: Last day on which verification may be completed, including any extension or reopening.

extension_count.meaning: Deadline extensions granted on the case.

verified_date.meaning: Date identity was verified on the case.

idv_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the identity verification activity record.

idv_case_id.meaning: Case the activity belongs to (foreign key -> idv_cases).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the row, from the idv charter.

attempt_number.meaning: Sequence of a proofing attempt on the case.

attempt_at.format: ISO timestamp; empty when not an attempt

attempt_result.meaning: Result of a proofing attempt; not_applicable for other activities.

document_type.meaning: Kind of document received; not_applicable for other activities.

document_role.meaning: Requirement the document is offered to satisfy.

received_date.format: YYYY-MM-DD; empty when not a document
received_date.meaning: Date the document reached the agency.

postmark_date.meaning: Postmark date of a mailed document.

appointment_date.format: YYYY-MM-DD; empty when not an appointment
appointment_date.meaning: Date of a booked or missed appointment.

appointment_location.meaning: Office name or 'video' for an appointment, exactly as shown in the booking system; empty when not an appointment.

scheduled_date.format: YYYY-MM-DD; empty when not a booking
scheduled_date.meaning: Date the appointment booking was made.

overpayment_id.meaning: Primary id of the overpayment (one determination against one claim).

customer_id.meaning: Claimant who owes the overpayment (foreign key -> customers).

claim_id.meaning: Claim on which the overpaid weeks were paid (foreign key -> claims).

variant_name.meaning: Classification of the overpayment, written as the official classification name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle status of the overpayment as defined in the overpay charter lifecycle.

determination_date.meaning: Date the overpayment determination was issued and mailed; appeal, waiver, interest and collection periods count from it.

cause.meaning: Issue that made the overpaid weeks not payable.

principal_amount.meaning: Total benefits overpaid for the weeks, as established.

balance_due.format: USD, 2 decimal places (negative means a credit owed to the claimant)
balance_due.meaning: Amount still owed across all components; always equal to the sum of the overpayment_balance deltas in overpay_ledger (assessments in minus recoveries and adjustments out).

disqualification_weeks.meaning: Fraud penalty weeks imposed by the determination; 0 for non-fraud.

repayment_plan_status.meaning: Status of the repayment plan on the overpayment; none when no plan was set.

repayment_plan_monthly_amount.format: USD, 2 decimal places; 0.00 when no plan
repayment_plan_monthly_amount.meaning: Monthly installment of the current plan.

repayment_plan_start_date.meaning: Due date of the first installment of the current plan.

top_referral_status.meaning: Status of referral for federal (Treasury Offset Program) and state tax refund offset.

top_notice_date.meaning: Date the notice of intent to refer was mailed.

closed_date.meaning: Date the overpayment reached paid_in_full, waived, cancelled or written_off.

overpay_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the overpayment ledger entry.

event_type.meaning: Event family of the row, from the overpay charter.

amount.meaning: Amount of the entry; the account direction is given by the event family (assessments, returns and refunds in; recoveries and adjustments out).

accrual_month.meaning: Calendar month an interest entry is for.

fee_type.meaning: Kind of fee for a fee entry; none otherwise.

payment_reference.meaning: Confirmation number of a repayment exactly as issued by the payment channel (also used to tie returns, fees and refunds to it); empty otherwise.

payment_channel.meaning: Channel of a voluntary repayment; not_applicable otherwise.

intercept_source.meaning: Source of a tax refund intercept; not_applicable otherwise.

intercept_reference.meaning: Reference number of an intercept exactly as reported by the offsetting agency; empty otherwise.

source_payment_id.meaning: Benefit payment an offset was taken from (foreign key -> claim_ledger); empty otherwise.

source_payment_amount.meaning: Gross payable amount of the benefit payment an offset was taken from.

week_ending_date.meaning: Benefit week of the payment an offset was taken from.

waiver_request_id.meaning: Waiver request decided by a waiver adjustment (foreign key -> overpay_waiver_requests); empty otherwise.

appeal_id.meaning: Appeal whose decision reversed the determination, for a cancellation adjustment or refund (foreign key -> appeals); empty otherwise.

refund_basis.meaning: Why a refund is owed; none for other entries.

waiver_request_id.meaning: Primary id of the waiver request lodged by the claimant.

overpayment_id.meaning: Overpayment the waiver is asked for (foreign key -> overpayments).

request_date.meaning: Date the waiver request was received.

household_size.meaning: Household size stated by the claimant on the request.

annual_household_income.meaning: Annual household income stated by the claimant on the request.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

withholding_order_id.meaning: Primary id of the withholding election or deduction order.

customer_id.meaning: Claimant whose payments are subject (foreign key -> customers).

claim_id.meaning: Claim on which a voluntary election was made, or the claim open when an agency order arrived (foreign key -> claims).

values: Child Support Withholding — Current Support Order
SNAP Overissuance Recovery — Household or Agency Error
SNAP Overissuance Recovery — Intentional Program Violation
variant_name.meaning: Kind of election or order, written as the official name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle status as defined in the withhold charter lifecycle.

requested_date.meaning: Date the election or order was received.

effective_date.meaning: First payment date to which the election, order or latest amendment applies.

order_reference.meaning: IV-D case number or SNAP claim number exactly as printed on the order; empty for voluntary elections.

weekly_amount.meaning: Weekly amount stated on a child support order.

certified_amount.format: USD, 2 decimal places; 0.00 when not amount-limited
certified_amount.meaning: Total to be recovered under an arrears-only or SNAP order.

end_date.meaning: Last payment date to which the election or order applied.

withholding_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the withholding ledger entry.

withholding_order_id.meaning: Election or order booked (foreign key -> withholding_orders).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the row, from the withhold charter.

entry_date.meaning: Payment date of a deduction or skip, or date of a remittance or refund.

source_payment_id.meaning: Benefit payment a deduction was taken from or skipped on (foreign key -> claim_ledger); empty otherwise.

week_ending_date.format: YYYY-MM-DD (Saturday); empty unless deduction or skip

deduction_basis_amount.meaning: Amount the deduction rate was applied to.

amount.format: USD, 2 decimal places, always positive; 0.00 for a skip
amount.meaning: Amount deducted, remitted or refunded; the account direction is given by the event family.

skip_reason.meaning: Why a deduction was skipped; none for other entries.

remittance_period.format: YYYY-MM for monthly, YYYY-MM-DD (period end) for semiweekly and per-payment batches; empty unless remittance

original_deduction_id.meaning: Deduction refunded by a refund entry (foreign key -> withholding_ledger); empty otherwise.

refund_reason.meaning: Why a deduction was refunded; none for other entries.

withholding_request_id.meaning: Primary id of the claimant's voluntary withholding request.

claim_id.meaning: Claim the request concerns (foreign key -> claims).

withholding_order_id.meaning: Election the request stops (foreign key -> withholding_orders); empty for a start request.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

appeal_id.meaning: Primary id of the appeal (docket number).

customer_id.meaning: Appellant, a claimant or an employer (foreign key -> customers).

values: Lower Authority Appeal — Able and Available Issue
Lower Authority Appeal — Overpayment and Fraud
Lower Authority Appeal — Employer Benefit Charge
Lower Authority Appeal — Employer Contribution Rate
Higher Authority Appeal — Board of Review
variant_name.meaning: Docket of the appeal, written as the official docket name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle status of the appeal as defined in the appeal charter lifecycle.

appellant_role.meaning: Whether the appellant is the claimant or an employer.

determination_record_id.meaning: The appealed record: the claim (separation, able-and-available, monetary), the overpayment, the charge position, the employer account (contribution rate) or the lower-authority appeal (Board).

claim_id.meaning: Claim concerned (foreign key -> claims); empty for contribution rate appeals.

employer_account_id.meaning: Employer account concerned (foreign key -> employer_accounts); empty when no employer account is involved.

parent_appeal_id.meaning: For a Board of Review appeal, the lower-authority appeal decided (foreign key -> appeals); empty otherwise.

determination_mailed_date.meaning: Mailing date of the appealed determination or decision; the filing deadline counts from it.

filed_date.meaning: Filing date: postmark, fax or online submission date.

filing_channel.meaning: Channel through which the written appeal was filed.

late_filing_reason.meaning: Good cause stated for a late filing; none when filed on time.

hearing_date.format: YYYY-MM-DD; empty when no hearing is set
hearing_date.meaning: Date of the currently set hearing.

decision_outcome.meaning: Outcome of the decision; pending until issued.

decision_mailed_date.format: YYYY-MM-DD; empty until a decision or dismissal is mailed
decision_mailed_date.meaning: Mailing date of the decision or dismissal.

dismissal_reason.meaning: Why the appeal was dismissed; none otherwise.

closed_date.format: YYYY-MM-DD; empty until closed or withdrawn
closed_date.meaning: Date the appeal became final at this level or was withdrawn.

appeal_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the appeal activity record.

appeal_id.meaning: Appeal the activity belongs to (foreign key -> appeals).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the row, from the appeal charter.

hearing_date.meaning: Hearing set, or the hearing a postponement request concerns.

hearing_time.format: HH:MM (24-hour, local time); empty unless a setting
hearing_time.meaning: Start time of a hearing setting.

notice_mailed_date.meaning: Date the hearing notice was mailed.

schedule_reason.meaning: Why a hearing setting was made.

requested_by.meaning: Party who made the request or submitted the exhibit.

request_date.format: YYYY-MM-DD; empty when not a request
request_date.meaning: Date a postponement or interpreter request was received.

exhibit_status.meaning: Whether an exhibit met the exhibit deadline.

appeal_request_id.meaning: Primary id of the appellant's request on an appeal.

appeal_id.meaning: Appeal the request concerns (foreign key -> appeals).

customer_id.meaning: Party making the request (foreign key -> customers).

stated_reason.meaning: Good cause or purpose stated with the request; none for a plain withdrawal.

request_status.meaning: Outcome of the request; confirmed_by_appellant applies to withdrawals.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

employer_account_id.meaning: Primary id of the employer's unemployment insurance tax account.

customer_id.meaning: Employer holding the account (foreign key -> customers).

variant_name.meaning: Financing class of the account, written as the official class name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle status of the account as defined in the taxacct charter lifecycle.

ui_account_number.meaning: State unemployment insurance account number printed on notices, exactly as issued (format LK- followed by 7 digits).

entity_type.meaning: Legal form of the employer, which decides whether reimbursing financing is available.

naics_code.meaning: NAICS industry code of the employer's principal activity.

contribution_rate.format: decimal rate, 4 decimal places (0.0270 = 2.70%); 0.0000 for reimbursing
contribution_rate.meaning: Contribution rate in force for rate_year.

rate_year.meaning: Calendar rate year of the contribution rate on file.

reserve_ratio.meaning: Reserve ratio the current rate rests on; 0.0000 for classes not experience rated.

rate_notice_date.meaning: Mailing date of the latest rate notice.

average_annual_taxable_payroll.meaning: Average annual taxable payroll of the fiscal years ending on the latest computation date.

balance_due.format: USD, 2 decimal places (negative is a credit)
balance_due.meaning: Amount owed; always equal to the sum of the contribution_balance_due deltas in employer_tax_ledger.

reserve_balance.meaning: Experience-rating reserve; always equal to the sum of the reserve_account_balance deltas in employer_tax_ledger; 0.00 for reimbursing employers.

predecessor_account_id.meaning: Predecessor account whose experience was transferred in (foreign key -> employer_accounts); empty when none.

transfer_effective_date.meaning: Effective date of an experience transfer in.

class_effective_date.meaning: Date the current financing class took effect.

inactive_since_quarter.meaning: First quarter without wages of an inactive account.

wage_report_id.meaning: Primary id of the quarterly contribution and wage report.

event_type.meaning: Event family of the row, from the taxacct charter.

report_type.meaning: Original report, amended report, or final report marking the last quarter of wages.

due_date.meaning: Due date of the quarter's report (last day of the month after the quarter).

total_wages.meaning: Total wages paid in the quarter.

excess_wages.meaning: Wages above the taxable wage base per employee, counted cumulatively over the calendar year.

employee_count_month1.meaning: Employees on the 12th of the quarter's first month.

employee_count_month2.meaning: Employees on the 12th of the quarter's second month.

employee_count_month3.meaning: Employees on the 12th of the quarter's third month.

tax_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the tax ledger entry.

event_type.meaning: Event family of the row, from the taxacct charter.

component.meaning: Balance component of a balance-due entry; not_applicable for reserve and refund entries.

amount.meaning: Amount of the entry; the account and direction are given by the event family.

assessment_basis.meaning: What a contribution assessment rests on.

contribution_rate_applied.format: decimal rate, 4 decimal places; 0.0000 when not an assessment
contribution_rate_applied.meaning: Rate used by a contribution assessment.

accrual_month.meaning: Month of lateness an interest entry is for.

payment_reference.meaning: Confirmation number of a payment exactly as issued by the payment channel; empty otherwise.

rate_year.format: YYYY; empty unless a voluntary contribution
rate_year.meaning: Rate year a voluntary contribution is meant to lower.

bill_due_date.format: YYYY-MM-DD; empty unless a reimbursement bill
bill_due_date.meaning: Due date of a reimbursement bill.

predecessor_account_id.meaning: Predecessor account of a reserve transfer in (foreign key -> employer_accounts); empty otherwise.

successor_account_id.meaning: Successor account of a reserve transfer out (foreign key -> employer_accounts); empty otherwise.

account_request_id.meaning: Employer request a refund is paid against (foreign key -> employer_account_requests); empty otherwise.
Primary id of the employer's request on its tax account.

employer_account_id.meaning: Account the request concerns (foreign key -> employer_accounts).

quarter.meaning: Quarter the request concerns (penalty abatement, final quarter of a closure).

requested_amount.format: USD, 2 decimal places; 0.00 when no amount

request_status.meaning: Outcome of the request; confirmed_by_employer applies to closures.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

charge_position_id.meaning: Primary id of the employer's chargeable position on one claim.

employer_account_id.meaning: Employer tax account charged (foreign key -> employer_accounts).

claim_id.meaning: Claim the charges arise from (foreign key -> claims).

variant_name.meaning: Charge class of the employer on the claim, written as the official class name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle status of the position as defined in the charge charter lifecycle.

notice_mailed_date.meaning: Date the notice of claim was mailed to the employer.

response_due_date.meaning: Last day for a timely response to the notice of claim.

response_date.meaning: Date the employer's response was received.

response_timeliness.meaning: Timeliness of the employer's response; pending until the window ends, none when no response came.

base_period_wages_paid.meaning: Wages this employer paid the claimant in the claim's base period.

charge_share_pct.meaning: This employer's share of each payment's charge.

total_charged.meaning: Benefits charged to the position; always equal to the sum of the charged_benefits deltas in charge_ledger.

relief_basis.meaning: Ground on which relief was granted; none when not relieved.

protest_date.meaning: Date the latest protest was received.

protest_ground.meaning: Ground raised by the latest protest; none when no protest.

charge_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the charge ledger entry.

event_type.meaning: Event family of the row, from the charge charter.

source_payment_id.meaning: Benefit payment a charge comes from (foreign key -> claim_ledger); empty otherwise.

source_payment_amount.format: USD, 2 decimal places; 0.00 unless a charge
source_payment_amount.meaning: Gross payable amount of the benefit payment charged.

week_ending_date.meaning: Benefit week of the payment charged.

charge_quarter.meaning: Calendar quarter in which a charge or credit is posted, or which a statement covers.

amount.format: USD, 2 decimal places, always positive; 0.00 for a statement
amount.meaning: Charge or credit amount; the direction is given by the event family.

source_charge_id.meaning: Posted charge a credit reduces (foreign key -> charge_ledger); empty otherwise.

statement_mailed_date.meaning: Mailing date of a statement of charges.

protest_due_date.meaning: Last day for a timely protest of the statement.

charge_request_id.meaning: Primary id of the employer's submission on a position.

charge_position_id.meaning: Position the submission concerns (foreign key -> charge_positions).

separation_reason_reported.meaning: Separation reason stated in a response.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
